name: worklog
description: Logs every Claude Code session into one readable file per day: your messages, plus the reports, tickets, PRs and kubectl actions from the replies.

log_dir.title: Log folder
log_dir.description: Where daily logs are saved. Pick a folder that syncs between your own Macs (iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox). Don't pick one shared with other people: logs hold your full messages. Tip: /worklog:setup opens a Finder picker instead.

logging_enabled.title: Logging
logging_enabled.description: Turn off to stop logging. Chats while it's off are never logged, not even later.

keep_days.title: Keep logs for (days)
keep_days.description: Delete this computer's day files older than this many days. 0 keeps them forever.

backfill_from.title: Backfill from (YYYY-MM-DD)
backfill_from.description: Never log anything older than this date, including past chats logged at setup. Leave empty for everything still on disk.
